<infobox theme="Battle300">
        <data source="relatedevents"><label>Related events</label></data>	
        <data source="proposedby"><label>Proposed by</label></data>	
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
<navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header></header>	
        <data source="date"><label>Date</label></data>	
        <data source="government"><label>Government</label></data>
        <data source="electorate"><label>Electorate</label></data>	
        <data source="result"><label>Result</label></data>	
        <data source="candidates"><label>Candidates</label></data>	
        <data source="otherkeyindividuals"><label>Other key individuals</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Election|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}{{#invoke:EventDateCheck|main}}<noinclude>[[category:Event infobox templates]]{{clear}}

===Usage===
To use this template, paste the following code into the top of the article, filling all relevant fields:
<pre><nowiki>
{{Top}}
{{Election
|relatedevents=
|proposedby=
|name=
|image=
|date=
|government=
|electorate=
|result=
|candidates=
|otherkeyindividuals=}}
</nowiki></pre></noinclude>
